workflow_name: Clang-tidy static analysis (Ubuntu 24.04, Python 3.12, Clang-18, Clang-tidy-18)
author: mvafin
title: Build-gpu / Build fails downloading node-api-headers due to HTTP 502 from github.com
signature: downloading node api headers failed http response code 502|Network
root_cause: CMake FetchContent attempted to download node-api-headers v1.9.0 from github.com during the GPU build configure step. The download failed with HTTP 502 Bad Gateway from codeload.github.com (x-github-edge-region: westus2). This is a transient network/infrastructure failure on GitHub's CDN. The ci/gha_overall_status_clang_tidy job then failed as a downstream consequence of the build failure.
reproduction_steps: N/A - transient network issue, not reproducible on demand
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed Build-gpu / Build job - the failure is transient
If recurring, consider caching node-api-headers in the Docker image or using a mirror
prevention_strategies: Pre-cache third-party dependencies in the build container to avoid FetchContent network downloads at CI time. Add retry logic to CMake FetchContent downloads for transient network failures.
historical_context: This is the first recorded occurrence of this exact failure pattern in the MQ database.
